activity_summary: You wrote Anne in the familiar way. The wash stands at fourpence a week, already paid. You set the Christmas money down as so much for the house, so much for the shop's debts, and so much she may spend without writing first. You did not write the figures. You asked whether the string-and-spool engine still works, or has been forbidden. The page does not argue. It has not been sent.
